entries.title: I Chronicles 24:1
segments: And the divisions of the sons of Aaron [were]: The sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:2
segments: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons. And Eleazar and Ithamar were priests.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:3
segments: And David distributed them according to their offices in their service, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:4
segments: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar. And so they were divided. Among the sons of Eleazar [were] sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:5
segments: So they divided them by lot, one sort with another. For the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:6
segments: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the rulers, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and [before] the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites. One principal household was taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:7
segments: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:8
segments: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:9
segments: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:10
segments: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:11
segments: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:12
segments: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:13
segments: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:14
segments: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:15
segments: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:16
segments: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:17
segments: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:18
segments: the twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:19
segments: These [were] their orderings in their service to come into the house of the LORD, according to their manner, to Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:20
segments: And the rest of the sons of Levi: Of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:21
segments: Concerning Rehabiah, of the sons of Rehabiah, the first [was] Isshiah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:22
segments: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:23
segments: And the sons [of Hebron]: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:24
segments: [Of] the sons of Uzziel, Michah. Of the sons of Michah, Shamir.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:25
segments: The brother of Michah [was] Isshiah. Of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:26
segments: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Jaaziah, Beno.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:27
segments: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:28
segments: Of Mahli [was] Eleazar, who had no sons.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:29
segments: Of Kish, the son of Kish [was] Jerahmeel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:30
segments: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These [were] the sons of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:31
segments: And they also cast lots along with their brothers, the sons of Aaron, before David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, the head of the fathers, as well as his younger brother.
